Mathematics (B.A.)
Foundational Requirements
- MATH-UA 120 Discrete Mathematics (4 cr)
- MATH-UA 121 Calculus I (4 cr)
- MATH-UA 122 Calculus II (4 cr)
- MATH-UA 123 Calculus III (4 cr) or MATH-UA 129 Honors Calculus III
- MATH-UA 140 Linear Algebra (4 cr) or MATH-UA 148 Honors Linear Algebra
- MATH-UA 325 Analysis (See note 2 in Additional Information) (4 cr) or MATH-UA 328 Honors Analysis I
- MATH-UA 343 Algebra (4 cr) or MATH-UA 348 Honors Algebra I
Advanced Electives Requirement
- Three (3) advanced mathematics electives from the following list: (12 cr): MATH-UA 240 Combinatorics; MATH-UA 248 Theory of Numbers; MATH-UA 262 Ordinary Differential Equations; MATH-UA 268 Honors Ordinary Differential Equations; MATH-UA 263 Partial Differential Equations; MATH-UA 264 Chaos & Dynamical Systems; MATH-UA 329 Honors Analysis II; MATH-UA 333 Theory of Probability; MATH-UA 338 Honors Theory of Probability; MATH-UA 334 Mathematical Statistics; MATH-UA 349 Honors Algebra II; MATH-UA 352 Numerical Analysis; MATH-UA 358 Honors Numerical Analysis; MATH-UA 353 Linear and Nonlinear Optimization; MATH-UA 375 Topology; MATH-UA 377 Differential Geometry; MATH-UA 382 Functions of a Complex Variable; MATH-UA 393 Honors I; MATH-UA 394 Senior Honors II; MATH-UA 397 Honors III; MATH-UA 398 Honors IV
